review.notes: Full review; the three findings of the previous review (0694f07) are repaired. Gate rerun on ccaed5e: OK (worker's run includes build=0). Depcheck: 235 roadmaps, 2258 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with exit 0 and three sorry warnings; #check of all nine declarations matches signatures.md with no lost binder; one-tactic probes (rfl/simp/infer_instance/aesop/exact?) fail on all three theorems. Seeded sample read in the cached texts: F1.2, F2.1, F2.4, F3.2, F3.3, F3.4, F4.1, F4.3, F4.4, F6.5, F7.1, F7.4, F7.5, F8.2, F8.3, plus the new locators of F3A.3, F7.2, F7.3 and F8.4. Every ReductiveGroupsPartII RG2.1/RG2.3/RG2.4 anchor and Check name resolves on main. Blocking: R01, KacMoody on main (Layer 8/KM8A, lines 79-86 and 1278-1280) assigns the comparison of its complex-point loop groups with Layer 3A to this roadmap, which assigns it back and claims KacMoody consumes Layer 3A; R02, the section 4.4 torus bullet (trivial groupoid) contradicts the fibre bullet and 'a torus oper is exactly a torus connection'. P3: two wrong locators (FG Lemma 4.3.1 vs 4.3.2; Frenkel Conjecture 10.1.2 is on p. 311); the FG section 1.1 locator is etale where the README uses fpqc; the headline regularGauge_constantCoeff_bijective has no locator; three Checks are false or vacuous (PGL2 Omega, S = R x R descent, psi = eps + 1/t).
